name: BOLT12 Pay
description: BOLT12 Pay is a self-hosted Lightning payments and identity app for LND nodes. It supports BOLT12 Offers, BIP353 and LNURL Lightning Addresses, optional BOLT11 fallback invoices, Nostr identities, NIP-05 and Zaps.
short_desc: Self-hosted Lightning payments and identity with BOLT12, BIP353, LNURL, and Nostr
author: Alex71btc

form_fields.hint: Network mode for Bitcoin node (mainnet, testnet, signet, regtest)
